publicConfig.seoDescription: Generate timed SRT and WebVTT subtitles from a public Instagram Reel. Get the original-language transcript and individual word timestamps.

faq.question: How do I make subtitles for my Instagram Reel?
faq.answer: ReelSaid's subtitle task takes a public Reel link. Paste it into Instagram URLs and start the task to get the timed transcript and subtitle files.

faq.question: Where do I download my SRT and WebVTT files?
faq.answer: ReelSaid's subtitle task includes SRT and WebVTT links in the result. Open a subtitle link with your Apify access and import the file into your editor.

faq.question: Does the Reel subtitle task preserve the spoken language?
faq.answer: ReelSaid creates subtitles in the original spoken language. Automatic language detection is on by default.

publicConfig.seoTitle: Instagram Reel Hook Finder and Comparison | ReelSaid
publicConfig.seoDescription: Compare the spoken hooks in the first three seconds of several Instagram Reels. Get opening lines, full transcripts, and available post metrics.

faq.question: What does the Instagram Reel hook finder return?
faq.answer: ReelSaid's hook finder returns any speech from the first three seconds, the full transcript, timing, and the original post metadata.

faq.question: How do I compare Reels from different creators?
faq.answer: Paste their public Instagram Reel links into the ReelSaid hook finder. The task returns one row for each distinct video so you can compare openings side by side.

faq.question: Can I send the hook results to a spreadsheet?
faq.answer: Export the ReelSaid hook dataset as CSV or Excel. Each row contains the transcript and opening hook for its video.

faq.question: Can ReelSaid monitor public personal accounts?
faq.answer: ReelSaid's monitoring task accepts a public personal, creator, or business Instagram handle or profile URL.

faq.question: What does the first scheduled run return?
faq.answer: ReelSaid monitoring can return eligible existing Reels on the first run. Later runs use your Apify account's answer history to skip previously answered videos.

faq.question: How do I schedule Instagram Reel monitoring?
faq.answer: Duplicate the ReelSaid monitoring task, add your public Instagram account, then attach an Apify schedule. Keep Only unanswered Reels enabled for recurring runs.

faq.question: Can I try ReelSaid with other spoken languages?
faq.answer: Set ReelSaid's language field to auto for detection or choose a supported language code for your public Instagram video.

faq.question: Can I use the Spanish transcript as subtitles?
faq.answer: ReelSaid's Spanish Reel task returns a timed transcript and an SRT file when usable timing is available. Download the file from the result.

title: Turn Instagram Reels into transcript data for AI
description: Bring public Instagram video records into an AI research workflow. Turn a list of posts into structured JSON with original-language transcripts, opening hooks, word timestamps, and source details for search, summaries, or quote extraction.

publicConfig.seoTitle: Instagram Reel Transcripts for AI Workflows | ReelSaid
publicConfig.seoDescription: Turn Instagram Reel records into structured JSON for AI research. Get transcripts, opening hooks, word timestamps, and post metadata.

faq.question: What should an AI agent send to ReelSaid?
faq.answer: Send ReelSaid public Instagram post records as datasetItems or give the Actor a readable Apify dataset ID. Keep the original post URL in each record.

faq.question: Which fields should I use for quotes and source links?
faq.answer: Use ReelSaid's transcript and wordLevelTimestamps for quotes, hook.text for the opening, and metadata.postUrl to link back to the original Instagram post.

faq.question: How does an AI agent retrieve the transcript rows?
faq.answer: Run ReelSaid through Apify MCP or the API with explicit sources. Read the returned dataset to get each transcript and its status, timestamps, and metadata.
